title: P3497 — Cylinder Deactivation System	Bank 2 | OBDHut
meaning: The PCM detected a fault in the cylinder deactivation system for Bank 2 (the cylinder bank opposite Bank 1, typically passenger side). This is a general fault code indicating overall system malfunction rather than a specific cylinder issue.
causes: The most common cause of P3497 (Cylinder Deactivation System Bank 2) is: Low or incorrect viscosity engine oil affecting hydraulic valve lifters
diagnose: Start by connecting an OBD2 scanner to read the code and any freeze frame data. Then follow the diagnostic steps specific to P3497 to identify the root cause.
